test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All Matter is Space.

Some Mass is Matter.

**Conclusions:**

A. All Mass is Space.

B. Some Mass is Space.

C. Some Space is Mass.

D. All Space is Mass.

E. All Matter is Mass.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e5066d0a3a009325a719da4fac096022d22f9bcfbe928e4a68c1334fe09536f.png] 

Conclusions:

A. All Mass is Space → False (it is possible but not definite)

B. Some Mass is Space → True (As All Matter is Space and Some Mass is Matter so, Some Mass is Space is true)

C. Some Space is Mass → True (As All Matter is Space and Some Mass is Matter so, Some Space is Mass is true)

D. All Space is Mass → False (it is possible but not definite)

E. All Matter is Mass → False (it is possible but not definite)

∴ Here, Conclusions B and C follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"B, C".**
